The decisive mistake was WikipediaHistory_Expert's claim at Step 7 that it had reviewed the November 2016 Featured log and found "Brachiosaurus" to be the only dinosaur article promoted that month. Both scraping attempts had returned empty results, so no real data supported the claim. The article name appears to have been invented, and the nominator "Cas Liber" that Wikipedia_Editor_Expert reported at Step 9 followed from it. The correct answer is FunkMonk.
